description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 makeprotseq: amount sequences of length lower case residues, each picked at random from the 20 amino acids (or with the composition of the first sequence of a pepstats file), with the insert put at start; the names are EMBOSS_001, EMBOSS_002 .... Equals the installed program on 300 runs (every input format of seqret, ranges, the output formats, the messages of the library; byte for byte). B09 WP62, F281.

length.description: The length of every sequence (-length, default 100).

insert.description: A string put into every sequence (-insert).

start.description: The position of the insert (-start, default 1).

pepstatsFile.description: The text of a pepstats output file (-pepstatsfile).

microseconds.description: The microseconds of the clock when the random number generator is seeded (the seed is microseconds % 9999 + 1; the program takes them from the clock of the machine): the same value gives the same sequences. Default: the clock.

outputFormat.description: The sequence output format (-osformat): fasta (default), embl, genbank, gcg, nbrf, ig, raw, msf, clustal, phylip, nexus, ... every format of seqret.

text.description: The standard output of the program (the sequences) or the text of its output file.

files.description: The files the program wrote, by name.

messages.description: What the library printed on the error stream (warnings and errors).

errors.message: The program died: the messages of the library (a value it refuses, an input no reader reads, a sequence of the wrong kind)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault is refused

examples.name: A run on a small input
